name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner glow at 30% opacity. This balances visibility for keyboard users with subtlety to avoid cluttering the interface. The trade-off is slightly reduced contrast for users with low vision, but the glow maintains enough distinction for most users.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with 30% glow risks disappearing on low-contrast backgrounds or when the glow blends into busy UI elements. Use a 3px solid ring with a 1px inner shadow instead—it meets WCAG 2.1 AA for focus visibility and survives mobile/touch fat-finger tests. Settle it with real device testing: if the ring stays visible in all themes and lighting, it’s done.
